lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 distinct high-luminance circular spots are visible in the central frame, arranged in four identifiable horizontal rows. A primary cluster of six spots forms two vertical columns of three in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of symmetry; high-luminance blobs are centered at these vertical-horizontal nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel linear features run horizontally across the flank. Each ridge exhibits a distinct vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch, consistent with a surface scrape or depigmentation, is visible on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, dark, elongated biological entities (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally and adjacent to the pectoral fin.
